thumb.trace: The thumb arises from the near radial side, bends down-left and ends in the broad nail pad on the cube right face.

index.trace: The nearer of the two clear left-contact fingers follows its own knuckle from the dorsal palm, bends down and ends in a nail-bearing tip against the cube upper-left edge.

middle.trace: The farther neighboring long ray has a separate upper contour and bent chain, ending in the outer left nail-bearing tip adjacent to the index.

ring.trace: A rear finger strip and a small nail/skin fragment below the two near fingers are visible at the cube left edge, but the object hides their connecting chain; they cannot be certified as one unique ring finger.

little.trace: The innermost rear ray descends behind the cube top and has no separately visible terminal pad. Its complete little-finger attachment, chain and tip cannot be traced.

hands.count_observation: Three complete rays are visible: thumb and the two adjacent left-contact fingers. Rear strips and the small lower fragment do not supply two independently traceable remaining fingers.
hands.length_observation: The near thumb, index and middle show plausible curved segment lengths for a bent grasp; the adjacent long fingers have similar overall spans with differing flexion, without enforcing an index/ring ordering. The two rear ray centerlines terminate behind the cube, so their full lengths and the little-finger relationship are unresolved.
hands.joint_observation: Visible near rays join the right dorsal hand continuously with plausible bends. The cube hides rear endpoints and makes their separate joint chains unverifiable. Fingers that are actually visible, palm/back of hand, wrist and short forearm fit; uncertain regions are object occlusions.
